blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Existing continuous space-time video super-resolution methods often infer motion from only two endpoint frames and model the two motion directions independently, making them vulnerable to ambiguous correspondence and inconsistent trajectories. We introduce a continuous STVSR framework that combines long-context encoding, continuous HR feature lifting, and an endpoint-anchored PixelSpline. Long-range observations provide more reliable endpoint representations, while continuous upsampling constructs detailed appearance features directly on the requested HR grid. PixelSpline explicitly models each pixel's motion as a single continuous trajectory shared by both endpoints. Using this trajectory, our method warps endpoint colors into a coarse intermediate frame and aligns the HR features for residual reconstruction. Experiments across spatial and temporal upsampling settings demonstrate that the proposed framework offers a favorable quality--efficiency trade-off.
blocks.zh: 现有的连续时空视频超解析方法经常从两个端点框推断运动,独立地模拟两个运动方向,使其易受模糊的函式和不一致的轨迹的影响. 我们引入一个连续的STVSR框架,将长文本编码,连续的HR特征提升,以及端点-受干扰的像素Spline结合起来. 长距离观测提供了更可靠的端点表示,而连续的上取样则直接在请求的HR网格上构建详细的外观特征. 像素Spline明确模拟每个像素的运动,作为两个端点共享的单个连续轨迹. 利用这个轨迹,我们的方法 曲轴端点颜色 成粗糙的中间框 并协调 HR 的特性 用于剩余重建。 跨空间和时间更新抽样环境的实验表明,拟议框架提供了有利于质量效率的权衡。

blocks.en: Video super-resolution (VSR) aims to recover high-resolution (HR) videos from low-resolution (LR) observations. It is important for video capture, display, editing, and analysis, where spatial resolution is often limited by camera hardware, transmission bandwidth, or storage. However, improving spatial resolution alone does not resolve temporal undersampling: a sharp video can still exhibit discontinuous motion when recorded at a low frame rate. Video frame interpolation (VFI) addresses this limitation by synthesizing frames at unobserved time steps, but it cannot recover spatial details already lost in the LR inputs. Space-time video super-resolution (STVSR) therefore combines VSR and VFI to reconstruct videos with both higher spatial resolution and higher frame rate. More recently, continuous STVSR (C-STVSR) has generalized this objective further, allowing a video to be queried at arbitrary spatial scales and continuous time coordinates.
blocks.zh: 视频超分辨率(VSR)旨在从低分辨率(LR)观测中取回高分辨率(HR)视频. 对于视频捕捉、显示、编辑和分析来说,这一点很重要,因为空间分辨率往往受到相机硬件、传输带宽或存储的限制。 然而,仅凭空间分辨率的提高并不能解决时间下取样问题:一个锐利的视频在以低帧率录制时仍然可以显示不连续的运动. 视频帧内插(VFI)通过在不可见的时间步骤下合成帧来解决这一限制,但它无法恢复LR输入中已经丢失的空间细节. 因此,空间时段视频超分辨率(STVSR)结合了VSR和VFI,以更高的空间分辨率和更高的帧率来重建视频. 最近,连续STVSR(C-STVSR)进一步概括了这一目标,允许以任意的空间尺度和连续的时间坐标询问视频。

blocks.en: Early STVSR approaches either connect VFI and VSR models with two-stage settings or jointly optimize the two tasks for predefined integer upsampling factors. One-stage methods such as Zooming Slow-Mo [ 27 ] and TMNet [ 28 ] demonstrate the benefit of joint spatial and temporal reconstruction. Continuous methods instead model video as a function over space and time. VideoINR [ 6 ] uses implicit functions for spatial appearance and time-dependent motion. MoTIF [ 4 ] models forward motion trajectories and splats endpoint features to a queried time, while BF-STVSR [ 14 ] introduces B-spline motion modeling together with a Fourier-based spatial representation. V 3 [ 3 ] recently explores a unified 3D Fourier field that avoids explicit warping.
blocks.zh: 早期的STVSR方法要么将VFI和VSR模型与两相设置相连接,要么联合优化两个任务,用于预定义的整数上乘因子. 单阶段方法如"缩放慢跑-Mo"[27]和TMNet[28]证明了联合空间和时间重建的好处. 持续的方法代替模拟视频在时空上的功能. VideoINR [6] 使用隐含的功能进行空间外观和时间依赖运动. MoTIF [4] 模型向前运动轨迹和花板端点特征到一个被询问的时间,而BF-STVSR [14] 则引入了B-斯普林运动模型,并配有以傅里叶为基础的空间代表. V 3 [3] 最近探索出一个统一的3D Fourier 字段,避免了明显的witching.

blocks.en: Despite this progress, three closely related challenges remain. First, a correspondence inferred from only two endpoint frames can be ambiguous in occluded or disoccluded regions, and can be corrupted by motion blur, repetitive texture, weak texture, or large displacement. A mistaken endpoint match then affects every intermediate time queried between the pair, often producing ghosting, temporal jumps, or unstable structures. A longer temporal context can reduce this ambiguity: content hidden at one endpoint may be visible in an earlier or later frame, repeated observations provide additional evidence for motion direction, and trajectories observed over several frames help distinguish persistent motion from pairwise matching noise. Second, existing continuous methods generally evaluate the motion fields from the two endpoints to the target time separately. Even when the two directions share network parameters, their predictions are conditioned on different endpoint features or motion latents, without an explicit constraint that corresponding endpoint pixels follow the same physical curve. The two warps can therefore transport corresponding content toward inconsistent target locations. Third, arbitrary-scale temporal synthesis requires endpoint appearance features on the requested HR grid. Fixed-scale upsamplers cannot serve arbitrary spatial queries, while warping only LR features postpones the construction of spatial detail until the final decoder. It is therefore desirable to lift the endpoint features continuously before temporal transport.
blocks.zh: 尽管取得了这些进展,但仍然存在三个密切相关的挑战。 首先,仅从两个端点框架推断出的函文在被占有或被忽略的区域中可能模糊不清,并被运动模糊,重复的纹理,弱的纹理所腐蚀,或被大量转移. 错误的终点匹配会影响每一次在对对之间被询问的中间时间,经常产生幽灵,时间跳跃,或不稳定的结构. 较长的时间上下文可以减少这种模糊性:一个端点所隐藏的内容可能在更早或更晚的帧中可见,重复的观察为运动方向提供了额外的证据,在多帧上观察到的轨迹有助于区分持久性运动和对等相配噪声. 其次,现有的连续方法一般从两个终点到目标时间分别评价运动场. 即使两个方向共享网络参数,其预测也以不同的端点特征或运动潜伏为条件,没有明显的制约,使得相应的端点像素遵循相同的物理曲线. 因此,这两个曲面可以将相应的内容传送到不一致的目标地点。 第三,任意尺度的时间合成需要在所请求的HR网格上显示端点外观特征. 固定尺度的升标不能为任意的空间查询服务,而平分只有LR特征会将空间细节的构建推迟到最终解码器. 因此,最好在时间迁移之前不断取消终点特征。

blocks.en: To address these challenges, we propose a continuous STVSR framework composed of four stages. First, a long-context encoder aggregates information across multiple LR observations to produce target-pair-aware endpoint representations, improving correspondence estimation in ambiguous regions. Second, a CUF-based continuous feature upsampling module transforms the two LR endpoint representations into HR appearance features on the requested output grid, providing spatially detailed evidence before temporal synthesis. Third, we establish dense bidirectional endpoint correspondences and use them to construct an endpoint-constrained PixelSpline for every source pixel. Rather than predicting two endpoint-to-target trajectories, we construct one curve on the first endpoint’s correspondence grid and use the endpoint correspondence to express the same curve from the other endpoint. The two endpoint warps therefore traverse one shared path from opposite ends. At any target time, this trajectory is used twice: bicubic-upsampled endpoint colors are forward-warped and fused into a coarse, potentially blurry HR intermediate frame, while the lifted endpoint features are transported to the same target locations to form an aligned HR feature representation. Finally, a lightweight pointwise decoder converts the aligned representation into an HR residual, which is added to the coarse frame to obtain the final reconstruction. This design integrates geometry and appearance with distinct roles: the shared PixelSpline models how observed content moves, whereas the decoder restores details that cannot be recovered through direct pixel transport.
blocks.zh: 为了应对这些挑战,我们提出由四个阶段组成的连续的STVSR框架。 首先,一个长文本编码器将跨多个LR观测的信息汇总,生成目标-pair-aware端点表示,改进了模糊区域的函证估计. 其次,一个基于CUF的连续特征提升样本模块将两个LR端点表示转化为所请求输出网格上的HR外观特征,在时间合成前提供空间上的详细证据. 第三,我们建立密集的双向端点对应,并利用它们为每个源像素构建一个端点受约束的像素Spline. 我们不是预测两个端点对目标轨迹,而是在第一个端点的函授网格上构建出一道曲线,并用端点的函授来表达从另一个端点得到的同道曲线. 因此,两个端点会从相反的端口穿过一条共同的道路。 在任何目标时间,这种轨迹都会被使用两次:双立体加样的端点颜色被向前转动并被熔入粗糙而可能模糊的HR中间框架;而被升起的端点特征被传送到相同的目标地点,形成一个对齐的HR特征代表. 最后,一个轻量级点解码器会将对齐的表示转换为HR残基,被加入到粗体框来得到最终的重建. 这种设计融合了几何和外观,具有不同的角色:共享的像素Spline模型如何被观测到的内容移动,而解码器则恢复了无法通过直接像素传输来回收的细节.

blocks.en: Extensive experiments on standard STVSR benchmarks show that the proposed framework occupies a favorable point on the quality–efficiency trade-off. As shown in Fig. 1 , our method runs 2.24 × 2.24\times faster than the quality-leading V 3 baseline, with a PSNR that is only 0.90 dB lower.
blocks.zh: 对标准STVSR基准的广泛试验表明,拟议框架在质量-效率取舍方面占据有利位置。 如图1所示,我们的方法运行速度比质量领先的V 3基线快2.24×2.24\时,其中PSNR只有0.90分贝更低.

blocks.en: Our main contributions are summarized as follows: • We introduce long-context endpoint encoding that uses observations beyond the queried pair to obtain more stable and globally informed endpoint representations. • We propose an endpoint-anchored shared PixelSpline that explicitly models per-pixel motion as one continuous trajectory evaluated from both endpoints. • We develop a CUF-based continuous feature lifting module that adapts continuous upsampling filters to map context-enhanced LR endpoint features onto arbitrary HR grids before trajectory-guided temporal transport.
blocks.zh: 我们的主要贡献概述如下: 我们采用长文本端点编码,利用被问对子之外的观察,以获得更稳定和全球知情的端点表述。 我们提出一个端点-指定共享的像素Spline,明确模拟每个像素的运动,作为从两个端点评价的一个连续轨迹。 我们开发了一个基于CUF的连续特性提升模块,该模块在轨迹制导时间迁移前,将连续的上下取样过滤器用于将上下文增强的LR端点特征映射到任意的HR网格上.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Early arbitrary-scale image super-resolution predicts scale-conditioned reconstruction filters, as in Meta-SR [ 12 ] . Coordinate-based methods subsequently model an image as a continuous function: LIIF [ 5 ] decodes local features at arbitrary queries, while LTE [ 16 ] and Thera [ 2 ] use sinusoidal representations to better preserve high-frequency content and control aliasing across scales. SAVSR [ 17 ] and ST-AVSR [ 22 ] extend arbitrary spatial magnification to video by exploiting neighboring frames, but retain the original temporal grid. These developments motivate lifting video features continuously in space, but do not address interpolation at unseen times by themselves.
blocks.zh: 早期的任意尺度图像超分辨率预测了有尺度条件的重建过滤器,如Meta-SR [12]. 以坐标为主的方法随后将图像建模为连续函数:LIIF [5]在任意查询时解码出本地特征;而LTE [16]和Thera [2]则使用sinusoid表示来更好地保存高频内容并控制跨尺度的别名. SAVSR [17]和ST-AVSR [22]通过利用相邻相框将任意的空间放大扩展至视频,但保留了原来的时间网格. 这些事态发展促使不断在空间中提升视频功能,但本身并不涉及在不为人知的时代进行插入。

blocks.en: Classical STVSR pipelines combine frame interpolation [ 13 , 1 ] with image or video super-resolution [ 30 , 25 ] . One-stage methods instead learn spatial and temporal reconstruction jointly. Zooming Slow-Mo [ 27 ] employs bidirectional deformable ConvLSTMs, TMNet [ 28 ] introduces temporal modulation, and subsequent architectures improve cross-frame propagation and aggregation [ 9 , 8 , 10 , 11 ] . These models are effective at their trained integer factors, but do not provide continuous space-time queries. Recently, Time Without Time [ 7 ] improves their pretraining through masked pseudo-temporal sequences, while retaining the same fixed-scale formulation.
blocks.zh: 古典STVSR管将帧内插[13, 1]与图像或视频超分辨率[30, 25]结合. 第一阶段的方法是共同学习空间和时间重建。 缩放慢-Mo [27] 采用可双向变形的ConvLSTM,TMNet [28] 引入了时间调制,而后的结构改善了跨帧传播和聚合[9,8,10,11]. 这些模型在经过训练的整数因子上是有效的,但不能提供连续的时空查询. 最近,"时间没有时间"[7]通过被蒙住的伪时序改进了它们的预训,同时保留了同一种固定尺寸的配体.

blocks.en: Continuous STVSR removes this restriction by treating space and time as query coordinates. VideoINR [ 6 ] combines an implicit spatial representation with backward motion, and MoTIF [ 4 ] models forward trajectories and splats endpoint features to the target time. BF-STVSR [ 14 ] augments this formulation with Fourier features and B-spline motion, whereas V 3 [ 3 ] represents the video as a unified 3D Fourier field without explicit warping. Pairwise trajectory methods, however, construct a query from two anchor-attached representations and model the two transport directions separately; V 3 uses broader temporal context but does not ensure explicit correspondence-consistent geometry. Our method brings these complementary ideas together by using long-context endpoint features to construct one endpoint-anchored PixelSpline shared by both transport directions.
blocks.zh: 连续STVSR通过将空间和时间作为查询坐标来去除此限制. VideoINR [6]结合了暗含的空间代表与后向运动,而MOTIF [4] 模式前向轨迹和花板端点特征到目标时间. BF-STVSR [14] 以Fourier的特性和B-spline运动来增强这种配方,而V 3 [3] 代表了视频作为统一的3D Fourier 域而未有明显的扭曲. 然而,对等的轨迹方法从两个锚接的表示中构建出一个查询,并分别模拟两个运输方向;V 3使用更广泛的时间上下文,但不能确保清晰的相通相通几何. 我们的方法通过使用长文本端点特性来构建一个端点-被两个运输方向共享的像素Spline,将这些互补的想法汇集在一起.

blocks.en: 3.2 Target-Pair-Aware Context Encoding
blocks.zh: 3.2 目标对等软件上下文编码

blocks.en: We adopt the native multi-frame encoder of Zooming Slow-Mo [ 27 ] to extract temporally aggregated features from the LR input sequence. We augment its output with a target-pair attention module. This module enables the two anchor frames to exchange features with relevant frames across the entire encoded sequence.
blocks.zh: 我们采用了原生多帧编码器"缩放慢跑-Mo [27]",从LR输入序列中提取时间上汇总的特征. 我们用一个目标辅助关注模块来增加其产出。 这个模块使两个锚框能够在整个被编码的序列中与相关框交换特征.

blocks.en: Given N N LR frames, the encoder first extracts a three-level feature pyramid for each frame, we then align the features of adjacent frames. The two aligned features are fused by a 1 × 1 1\times 1 convolution to obtain an interval feature. blocks.en: We evaluate our method on the full continuous space-time video super-resolution (C-STVSR) task, as well as on spatial-only and temporal-only reconstruction. We report reconstruction accuracy, temporal consistency, and end-to-end runtime to assess the quality achieved by each method relative to its inference cost.

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en:

supervision, the first and last frames of a nine-frame high-frame-rate sequence
define the endpoint pair, and three timestamps are randomly sampled from the
sequence as targets. Training uses 64 × 64 64\times 64 low-resolution crops with random flipping and rotation. We train the model with Adam optimizer ( β 1 = 0.9 \beta_{1}=0.9 , β 2 = 0.99 \beta_{2}=0.99 ), using an initial learning rate of 10 − 4 10^{-4} and cosine annealing to 10 − 7 10^{-7} . The pretrained SEA-RAFT [ 26 ] and GMFlow [ 29 ] components in Shared PixelSpline Modeling remain frozen, while all other components are trained from scratch.

blocks.en: Following the standard C-STVSR protocol [ 6 , 4 , 14 , 3 ] , we train on the training split of Adobe240 [ 24 ] . Adobe240 contains 133 high-frame-rate videos captured at 240 fps with a spatial resolution of 1280 × 720 1280\times 720 . We construct the low-resolution inputs by bicubic spatial downsampling and temporally subsample the videos by a factor of 8 8 , producing 30-fps input sequences. The remaining high-frame-rate frames provide supervision at continuous temporal coordinates. We report in-distribution results on the Adobe240 test split and cross-dataset results on GoPro [ 15 ] and REDS [ 20 ] . We additionally use Vid4 [ 18 ] to evaluate the spatial-only and temporal-only boundary cases. No dataset-specific fine-tuning is performed for GoPro, REDS, or Vid4.
blocks.zh: 按照标准C-STVSR协议[6,4,14,3],我们训练Adobe240[24]的训练分出. Adobe240包含在240英尺处捕获的133个高帧率视频,空间分辨率为1280×720 1280\times 720. 我们通过二分位空间下取样构建出低分辨率输入,并在时间上对视频进行8个系数的分取,生成30-fps输入序列. 其余的高帧速率框架提供连续时间坐标的监督。 我们在GoPro[15]和REDS[20]上报告Adobe240测试分解和交叉数据集结果的分布结果。 我们还利用Vid4 [18] 来评价空间和时间上唯一的边界案例。 GoPro、REDS或Vid4没有进行数据集特有的微调。

blocks.en: We compare against six representative STVSR methods. Zooming Slow-Mo [ 27 ] and TMNet [ 28 ] are fixed-scale one-stage models, whereas VideoINR [ 6 ] , MoTIF [ 4 ] , BF-STVSR [ 14 ] , and V 3 [ 3 ] support continuous space-time reconstruction. Fixed-scale methods are evaluated only at scaling factors supported by their pretrained models; continuous methods are queried directly at the requested spatial and temporal coordinates.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了六种有代表性的STVSR方法. 缩放慢-摩 [27]和TMNet [28]是固定尺度的一相模式,而VideoINR [6],MOTIF [4],BF-STVSR [14],和V 3 [3]则支持连续的时空重建. 固定尺度方法只根据其预先训练过的模型所支持的缩放系数加以评价;在所要求的空间和时间坐标上直接询问持续的方法。

blocks.en: We evaluate reconstruction quality using PSNR and SSIM. In the joint C-STVSR evaluation, “Center” measures the input keyframes and the center frame of each interval, whereas “Average” includes every reconstructed output frame. The Adobe240, GoPro, and REDS experiments use S × 4 \mathrm{S}\!\times\!4 spatial and T × 8 \mathrm{T}\!\times\!8 temporal upsampling. For the boundary-case evaluation on Vid4, we separately set the temporal factor to × 1 \times 1 for spatial-only SR and the spatial factor to × 1 \times 1 for temporal-only SR. We further report temporal optical-flow consistency (tOF), end-to-end latency, and FPS.
blocks.zh: 我们使用PSNR和SSIM评估重建质量. 在C-STVSR联合评价中,“中心”衡量每个间隔的输入键框和中心框,而“Average”包括每个重建的产出框。 Adobe240,GoPro,和REDS的实验使用 S × 4\mathrm{S}\!\times\!4 空间和 T × 8\mathrm{T}\!\times\!8 时间上标. 对于Vid4的边界个案评价,我们将时间因子分别设定为x 1\times 1的空间专用SR,空间因子则设定为x 1\times 1的空间专用SR. 我们进一步报告时间光学流动一致性(tOF),端到端延迟性以及FPS.

Fig. 3 presents qualitative comparisons under S × 4 \mathrm{S}\!\times\!4 spatial and T × 8 \mathrm{T}\!\times\!8 temporal
upsampling. The first three rows show results on GoPro, while the last two rows show results on the more challenging REDS dataset. Across both datasets, our method better preserves fine textures and high-frequency structures. In the GoPro examples, it reconstructs sharper characters, whereas V 3 and BF-STVSR produce noticeably blurred text. This advantage remains evident on REDS: our method faithfully recovers the fine stripe patterns on the tiger and preserves the folded structure of the pedestrian’s shirt collar with smooth, well-defined boundaries. In comparison, V 3 and VideoINR over-smooth the collar and fail to separate its structural components, while BF-STVSR and MoTIF recover only its coarse shape and introduce jagged artifacts along the edges. These results demonstrate the ability of our method to preserve fine appearance details and coherent object boundaries across different data distributions.

blocks.en: 4.5 Ablation study.
blocks.zh: 4.5 校正研究。

blocks.en:
We evaluate all variants using their checkpoints at 10,000 iterations on the same randomly selected subset of the Adobe240 test set,
comprising 3,858 frames under S × 4 \mathrm{S}\!\times\!4 spatial and T × 8 \mathrm{T}\!\times\!8 temporal upsampling. The full model achieves 32.49 dB PSNR and 0.930 SSIM. Replacing the shared bidirectional trajectory controls with independently predicted forward and backward controls, while retaining the long-context architecture, reduces performance to 32.25 dB and 0.924, corresponding to a 0.24 dB PSNR drop. Removing the additional context frames and using only the two anchor frames further decreases performance to 31.80 dB and 0.918, a 0.69 dB drop relative to the full model. These results verify that both endpoint-consistent control sharing and long-range temporal context contribute to reconstruction quality.
blocks.zh:

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We presented a continuous space-time video super-resolution framework that combines long-context encoding, continuous HR feature upsampling, and an endpoint-anchored PixelSpline. By constructing a single correspondence-consistent trajectory shared by both endpoints, our method aligns pixel and feature transport while exploiting observations beyond the queried frame pair. Experiments across joint, spatial-only, and temporal-only super-resolution settings demonstrate competitive reconstruction quality, improved temporal consistency, and a favorable quality–efficiency trade-off.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍了一个连续的时空视频超分辨率框架,这个框架结合了长文本编码,连续的HR特征上标,以及端点-被选取的像素Spline. 通过构建一个两个端点共享的单一的相通相通轨迹,我们的方法在利用被询问框对之外的观测的同时,对像素和特性迁移进行比对. 跨越联合、空间唯一和时间唯一超解环境的实验显示,重建质量具有竞争力,时间一致性得到改善,质量效率也得到了有利的取舍。

blocks.en: Despite these results, the reconstruction performance in terms of PSNR and SSIM can be further improved, particularly compared with the quality-leading method in several settings. Moreover, although our method offers practical inference efficiency, its training process remains computationally demanding and time-consuming. Improving reconstruction accuracy while developing more efficient training strategies constitutes a promising direction for future work.
blocks.zh: 尽管取得了这些成果,但特别与若干情况下的质量领导方法相比,在重建方面,国家综合安全方案(PSNR)和综合安全方案(SSIM)的绩效可以进一步提高。 此外,虽然我们的方法提供了实际的推论效率,但其培训过程在计算上仍然要求很高并耗费时间。 提高重建的准确性,同时制定更有效的培训战略,是今后工作的一个有希望的方向。
